Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can lock a short product preview with the right stakeholders: 

Summary (30s):
- Problem: MediVance is looking to reduce inference latency for batch claims scoring and centralize embeddings for semantic search across clinical notes.
- Success criteria you called out: <10ms avg token latency for online scoring, batch throughput >= 250 rps, and deterministic retention policies for PHI.
- Next step: 30-minute product preview (high-level + ops/infra Q&A) with your engineering/infra lead and one product stakeholder.

Can you nominate 2–3 windows (PT timezone) that work for your team? To make it easy, we can run the session with: 
- Tue 22 Oct, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 22 Oct, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed 23 Oct, 11:00–11:30 PT (preferred for our infra folks)

If none of those work, send 2 alternatives and we’ll align. Also:
- Who from your side should join for the infra questions (CTO/Head of Infra recommended)?
- I’ve attached my discovery notes and a provisional mutual action plan template.
- Prep doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcDEF_MV-discovery
- Quick calendar link if easier: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Attachments: discovery-notes-MediVance.pdf (summary), MediVance-MAP.xlsx (MAP template)

Thanks — happy to iterate on times.

Best,
